domain_event_published_outside_outbox.defect_claim: A transactional write path in a service that registers the outbox publishes its domain event with eventBus.publish instead of OutboxPublisher.enqueue, so the event and the write can diverge.
premises: The method writes state inside a transaction (a query runner transaction or a transaction callback) before the cited publish.
The cited publish announces that write as a domain event other services act on, not telemetry or a log.
The service registers OutboxModule.forFeature, so OutboxPublisher.enqueue is available to this write path.
